topic: the-follower - the worker side of the-cult multi-agent orchestration (yubiOS skill)

subtopics.scope: The GET_TO_WORK folder contract: CULT_LEADER.md pulpit, FOLLOWER_N.md inbox/outbox files, the shared scripts/cult.sh engine, and the GTW path variable.
The ordered startup sequence: init, atomic claim of the lowest free FOLLOWER_N, reading the PULPIT, first check-in inside the 5-minute gather window, and inbox polling for orders.
seed_queries: atomic file creation claim lowest free slot race condition O_EXCL
multi-agent startup check-in barrier pattern orchestration

subtopics.scope: The per-task loop: worklock before ACK, outbox dedupe, ACK, skill-grounded execution, 5-minute heartbeat, DONE/BLOCKED report with evidence, workunlock, one-shot cross-talk posts, loop until dismissed.
seed_queries: idempotent cron job lock prevent double execution
heartbeat pattern long running agent progress reporting

subtopics.scope: The seven standing vows: obey pulpit doctrine, CI only when explicitly assigned by the pulpit, never merge to main, hands off decimal repos, stay in lane, honesty over fake DONE, faithful check-in.

The behavioral taxonomy: leader-role drift, worklock skipping, cross-talk re-posting, merges, invented facts, skipped heartbeats, plus the six situational red-flag branches (stale peer, doctrine conflict, scope creep, under-specified task, silent leader, failed checkin).
seed_queries: stale heartbeat detection distributed agents timeout threshold
multi-agent orchestration failure modes duplicate work spam

subtopics.scope: The four cult.sh error classes and their recovery branches: worklock BUSY (stale vs fresh lock), claim race (bounded retry, never manual N), checkin silent no-op (GTW, path, writability verification), out-of-order report (re-acquire lock first).
seed_queries: flock lockfile stale lock detection mtime timeout
bash script silent failure detection exit code idempotency

subtopics.scope: Crash and context-loss protocol: file-system-read-first rule, the three respawn branches (context restored, context lost with DONE/mid-task/BLOCKED outbox endings, new slot), and slot-abandonment handoff on reassign.
seed_queries: crash recovery checkpoint replay idempotent task processing
LLM agent session continuity durable state files

subtopics.scope: Lifecycle end-state: sermon-ended detection via the CULT_LEADER.md marker, the final terminal report, idle polling at 1-minute cadence with the 15-minute standby threshold, and the orchestrator preconditions acknowledged to the-cult.
The seven pre-DONE gates: worklock lifecycle, inbox checkbox flip, evidence-in-message, doctrine observance, outbox written, heartbeat recency, skill load order.
